title: Debugger Escalation Ladder v1
description: Receipt proving a stuck state was worked in ladder order: dispatch to the artifact that owns the symptom, then a breakpoint, then research. Each rung must cite an artifact that exists; a rung may only be entered after the previous rung ran and failed to resolve.

symptom.description: The stuck state in concrete terms. A vague symptom cannot select a dispatch layer.

attempts.description: Focused fix attempts made before this ladder. At two or more, the research rung is mandatory.

resolved.description: Whether this rung explained the stuck state. Only the final rung may be true.

layer.description: Dispatch rung only: which artifact owns this symptom.

artifact.description: Path to the evidence read. Must exist on disk.

cited.description: The specific field read from the artifact. Reading without citing is a guess wearing a receipt.

proof.description: Breakpoint rung only: path to a debugger.proof.v1 artifact.
